python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im19 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0019.png'))
# Frame 19: cam = (-0.5, 2.0, 270.0)
# Sofa is on the right side of the image
# Let's inspect the corners of the sofa base touching floor
# Sofa color is dark grey: ~ [60-90, 70-100, 80-110]
# Floor is ~ [170, 162, 145]
# Let's find sofa pixels near floor (v > 400, u > 300)
mask = (im19[:,:,0] < 100) & (im19[:,:,1] < 110) & (im19[:,:,2] < 120) & (im19[:,:,0] > 40)
coords = np.argwhere(mask)
coords = np.array([c for c in coords if c[1] > 320 and c[0] > 400])

import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame(coords, columns=['v', 'u'])
bottoms = df.groupby('u')['v'].max()
print('obs19 sofa bottom u min:', df['u'].min(), 'max:', df['u'].max())
print('obs19 sofa bottom v min:', bottoms.min(), 'max:', bottoms.max())
print('Bottom vertices:')
print('Leftmost sofa base (front-left corner in cam frame):', df['u'].min(), bottoms.loc[df['u'].min()])
print('Rightmost sofa base:', df['u'].max(), bottoms.loc[df['u'].max()])
print('Max v corner:', bottoms.idxmax(), bottoms.max())
"
